services.name: Commercial Electrical
services.shortDescription: Complete electrical solutions for offices, retail spaces, and commercial buildings.
services.fullDescription: Our commercial electrical services cover everything from initial design and installation to ongoing maintenance and emergency repairs. We work with businesses of all sizes to ensure their electrical systems are safe, efficient, and compliant with all regulations.

services.name: Residential Electrical
services.shortDescription: Professional home electrical installations, repairs, and upgrades for safe living.
services.fullDescription: From new home construction to renovations and repairs, we provide comprehensive residential electrical services. Our licensed electricians ensure your home's electrical system is safe, reliable, and meets all your family's needs.

services.name: Industrial Electrical
services.shortDescription: Heavy-duty electrical systems for manufacturing plants and industrial facilities.
services.fullDescription: We specialize in industrial electrical systems that can handle the demanding requirements of manufacturing and production environments. Our team has extensive experience with high-voltage systems, motor controls, and industrial automation.

services.name: Electrical Repairs
services.shortDescription: Fast and reliable repair services for all your electrical issues and emergencies.
services.fullDescription: Electrical problems can't wait. Our skilled technicians respond quickly to diagnose and repair any electrical issue, from minor problems to major system failures. We use advanced diagnostic tools to identify problems and implement lasting solutions.

services.name: Lighting Installation
services.shortDescription: Expert installation of indoor and outdoor lighting systems for any space.
services.fullDescription: Transform your space with professional lighting installation. We design and install energy-efficient lighting solutions that enhance aesthetics, improve functionality, and reduce energy costs.

services.name: Electrical Upgrades
services.shortDescription: Modernize your electrical system with panel upgrades and circuit additions.
services.fullDescription: Older electrical systems may not meet modern power demands. We upgrade electrical panels, add circuits, and modernize wiring to ensure your property can safely handle today's electrical loads.

services.name: Generator Installation
services.shortDescription: Backup power solutions to keep your property running during outages.
services.fullDescription: Never be left in the dark. We install and maintain standby generators that automatically provide power during outages, ensuring your home or business continues operating smoothly.

services.name: Emergency Services
services.shortDescription: 24/7 emergency electrical services for urgent repairs and power restoration.
services.fullDescription: Electrical emergencies require immediate attention. Our emergency response team is available 24/7 to handle urgent situations including power outages, electrical fires, and dangerous wiring issues.

services.name: Security Systems
services.shortDescription: Advanced security and surveillance system installation and monitoring.
services.fullDescription: Protect your property with professional security system installation. We design and install comprehensive security solutions including cameras, alarms, and access control systems.
